description: Use when you need bulk email validation, email list verification or to verify email lists before a send or import. Do not use for one address (email-check is cheaper), proving a mailbox exists (no SMTP probe) or sending email. Returns JSON checking up to 20 email addresses in one call: syntax, MX records, disposable, free and role flags, SPF, DMARC and a verdict each, plus counts by verdict for 0.02 USDC per call. Typical response time 2500 ms (p95). Category: Data.

emails.description: Email addresses to check, 1 to 20, e.g. ["jane@example.com", "info@ietf.org"]

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON
